narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Cube means three, so divide by three, and the cube root is nine thousand.
<bookmark mark='tower'/>Nine thousand times nine thousand times nine thousand is huge, far beyond twenty seven thousand.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A cube root is found from three equal groups, not by dividing by three.

narration: <bookmark mark='chk1'/>To check, multiply each root by itself three times, and thirty cubed gives twenty seven thousand.
